messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: HelioCorp renewal scheduled Mon. They want a 9-month term to sync with their fiscal window and asked if we can accept a PO.
Omar (AM): Sales ok'd a one-off 7% reduction for 9mo, conditional on PO and net30 invoice. Any legal concerns?
Leah (Legal): No blockers. I'll draft a short amendment that covers prorated term and explicit "no auto-renew". Need to ensure billing entity matches PO.
Tariq (Finance): Finance prefers PO + net30. If procurement sends PO in the next 24h I can finalize invoice and attach to DocuSign.
Maya (CSM): Procurement said PO HEL-5544 will be emailed today. I'll include the onboarding request (they want training within 10 business days of sign).
Ivy (Enablement): Ok I can prepare a 2-hour condensed workshop and an ROI one-pager. Need confirmation after signature to lock dates.
Maya (CSM): Sending envelope now with draft invoice attached.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope env_7f8e9a created and sent to procurement@heliocorp.com (status: sent).
Omar (AM): If signing >48h, propose we share the workshop agenda and ROI sample to keep momentum but gate live keys until payment clears.
Maya (CSM): Agreed. Noting renewal tracker: status=waiting_on_signature, risk=medium, notes=9mo amendment pending signature; invoice draft prepared; enablement requested post-sign.
Leah (Legal): If procurement redlines, ping me and I'll update language quickly.
Tariq (Finance): Will post final invoice once PO HEL-5544 arrives.
Maya (CSM): I'll follow up with procurement in 3 hours and update thread. /cc @Omar (AM) @Leah (Legal) @Tariq (Finance) @Ivy (Enablement)
